about: Acting cards (Brief 7 delivery, 6 Nov 2026): each feeling as face + body + timing (mild, strong, by age), transitions with beats, gaze, ages, playback rules, coarse gesture timings. Authored presets, not measured norms (notes/acting-NOTES.md). engine/cartoon/acting.js plays them (ZC.feel); build-library.mjs embeds this file. Bangla and extra English aliases added in Zancut (the delivery had almost none).

coordinateSystem.look: actor-local normalized eye offset: x left negative/right positive; y down negative/up positive
coordinateSystem.headRoll: positive tilt toward actor-right shoulder; verify renderer convention
coordinateSystem.screenMirror: Project actor-local coordinates through facing and camera; never relabel actor left as screen left.

eyeHeadChest.eyeMapping: look.x = residualHorizontalAngle / 20; look.y = residualVerticalAngle / 12; clamp to [-1,1]. These are rig mapping choices, not ocular anatomy limits.
eyeHeadChest.largeTargetRule: Allocate head yaw up to 45 degrees comfortably; ask locomotion/root orientation to cover remainder. Never exceed 75. Chest yaw is not an available dial.
eyeHeadChest.headFirstUse: Deliberate task-specific anticipation only; not automatically selected by age. Compensate eyes to keep world gaze stable.
eyeHeadChest.smallShiftRule: Use eyes only unless posture or scene intent requires the head.

thinking.directionRule: Choose a relevant away target; no fixed left/right mapping to memory, imagination or lying.

nervous.directionRule: Use short clusters separated by longer partner looks; do not continuously jitter.

heldObject.target: object attention anchor, not necessarily the grip

farObject.target: world anchor on the distant object

targetGeometry.angles: yaw = atan2(lateral, forward); elevation = atan2(vertical, horizontal distance); eye residual follows after head and root allocation. Geometry overrides typical ranges.

order: others following sound or the first reaction

bangladesh.status: Context-selectable art direction from the brief, not a measured rule for all Bangladeshis. No local timing/percentage study established.

byAge.toddler: Caregiver comfort and understanding take precedence over formal etiquette.
byAge.child: Brief glance down when addressed formally, then return to the adult; do not prevent engaged learning.
byAge.teen: Choose familiar-family or formal-school context rather than a permanent reserved pose.
byAge.adult: Reciprocal gaze in work and ordinary conversation; optional respectful glance in a formal exchange.
byAge.elder: Reciprocal attention remains normal; being older does not mean avoiding younger speakers.

settings.classroom: Respect and active eye contact can coexist; do not equate looking down with good behaviour.
settings.work: Clear reciprocal attention; hierarchy alone does not require submissiveness.
settings.faith: Use faith-specific and scene-specific posture; quiet hands alone do not define prayer.

blinks.policy: Prefer phrase breaks and completed gaze shifts, with irregular intervals. blinkRate controls frequency, not duration.
blinks.composition: A blink temporarily overrides lid toward 1 then restores the current expression; it never writes a persistent sleepy lid.

stateResolution: Begin from defaults, never the previous emotion.
Overlay the chosen mild/strong face and body.
Overlay the age-specific mild/strong face/body patch if present.
Apply age gestureScale to body angular/amplitude channels listed below, then clamp.
Apply any explicit scene constraints such as occupied hands and seated support.
playback.swayRule: Per-card sway wins; ages.sway supplies only a fallback when neither card nor age patch supplies sway.
playback.speedRule: Effective gesture/locomotion speed = card.timing.speed × ages.speed. Do not change voice/audio playback speed.
playback.onsetRule: Onset durations already express the emotion; divide each by ages.speed only. Do not divide again by card speed.
playback.holdRule: Hold × age holdMultiplier; hold=0 means no automatic strong-to-mild timer. Positive hold starts AFTER onset finishes.
playback.releaseRule: After a positive hold, blend to the same emotion mild card over 0.6 / ages.speed seconds unless a story event overrides it. This is intensity reduction, not emotional recovery.
playback.leadsRule: Eyes start at notice; other listed parts start successively through the first 35% of change. Unlisted channels start at change start. All arrive by change end.

easing.sink: u*u during change, smoothstep during settle

playback.settleRule: Optional angular/torso overshoot only; limit to 3.5% of change and clamp. Never overshoot tears, blink, pupil, categorical poses or contact targets.
playback.transitionRule: Capture actual current state at beat 0. Patch beats accumulate locally; final resolveTarget resets to the destination card for the selected age. Divide beat times by selected ages.speed only.

mouthChangePolicy.rule: Prefer crossfading rendered mouth shapes; if unsupported, switch at low mouth openness during a blink or cut. Never interpolate enum strings.

handChangePolicy.rule: Route via the motion system; preserve hand world position until a reachable path begins. If insufficient time, retain the old hand pose or extend the transition.

channelOwnership.rule: Speech owns phonemes; retain compatible smile/brow tone. Blink temporarily closes then restores expression lid. Contact/locomotion overrides emotional stance and occupied hands. World-target gaze owns look/headYaw/headPitch while tracking; emotional head pose is a constrained offset only when it preserves target contact. Never add gaze rotation twice.

playback.seedPolicy: Deterministic per actor/shot seed for repeatable blink and gaze jitter; do not synchronize all actors.
